minimumHeight.description: The minimum height of the region relative to the ellipsoid's surface, in meters. May be negative.

maximumHeight.description: The maximum height of the region relative to the ellipsoid's surface, in meters. May be negative.

minimumLatitude.description: The minimum latitude of the region, in radians. Must be in the range [-pi/2, pi/2].

maximumLatitude.description: The maximum latitude of the region, in radians. Must be in the range [-pi/2, pi/2].

minimumLongitude.description: The minimum longitude of the region, in radians. Minimum and maximum longitude must evaluate to (0 <= abs(maximumLongitude - minimumLongitude) <= 2 * pi).

maximumLongitude.description: The maximum longitude of the region, in radians. Minimum and maximum longitude must evaluate to (0 <= abs(maximumLongitude - minimumLongitude) <= 2 * pi).
